description: Input script of the real-clock program benchmarks (Kotlin PerfTest, Swift PerfTests; docs/performance/TEMPLEOS_PERFORMANCE_BENCHMARKS.md). Times are wall-clock milliseconds since the program started; the first warmupMs are not measured.

cycle: press LEFT (held: typematic 250 ms delay, then every 33 ms)

fallback: a program that ends under this script is measured again with the mouse only (input = mouse)
metrics: tonesPerSec (speaker changes passed to the platform)
